author: haiku
label: climb-05-01
changes: No junior questions or answers were supplied, so this rewrite was for clarity only. No behaviour of the flow was changed.
Added a summary paragraph that says how password sign-in works today and why the flow is shaped this way.
Added a terms section that defines OIDC, authorization code, PKCE, state, nonce, ID token, sub, attempt, pending link, origin, start_session, GETDEL and neutral message in one plain line each.
Replaced internal labels (T4, T6) in the diagram with the outcome text, and made the T10 refusal name both cases. The diagram itself is otherwise unchanged.

Turned the short notes into 12 numbered steps. Each step says what starts it, what it does, what data it keeps and what happens when it fails. Step 10 now explains the signup race in order, rather than as a separate note.
Merged the failure summary and the notes on failures into one table. Removed the duplicate lock and pending-link rows, and the unlinked-email row was merged with the other refusals.
Moved the schema change and the NULL password rule into a separate Build and rollout section, apart from how the system runs.
Moved the unlink rule into its own short section, because it is outside the diagram.
Turned the four assumptions into open questions. Assumption 1 is recorded as decided, with its reason. Assumptions 2 to 4 are kept as questions, each with a short reason.
Kept every fixed requirement from the brief, including the 10-minute limits, single-use callbacks, sub-based identity, the no-token-storage rule, and the single session path.
